method: Positive finite raster values at 250 m cell centres inside each polygon. Original NoData and negative values excluded. Prepared rasters are UInt8 0-100, cropped/masked to 2022 offshore planning regions; their zero includes missing data. Original regional rasters are audited where that region intersects the square. Percentages use the entire AOI, not only valid-data cells. This measures spatial data availability, not current ecological abundance.
